_comment: Alien strain definitions. Order = type id. weak = 150% damage taken, resists = 50%. structure_dps: damage per second to structures they are blocked by; door_mult multiplies that vs blast doors. core_dps: damage to the outpost core while gnawing it. corpse_height: metres added to the corpse pile of the cell it dies in. ichor: acid-green blood colour. abducts: drags exposed colonists to the map edge. mauls: strikes exposed colonists for maul_damage (colonists have 100 HP; at 0 they die, leaving remains). hunts: Snatcher - senses colonists (incl. turret crews) and goes for them. feed_rate: chance per second to stop and eat a corpse it stands on.

aliens.name: Stalker
aliens.trait: Small, low, six-legged pack hunter. Floods in fast, low HP.

aliens.name: Mauler
aliens.trait: Huge front-heavy brute: plated shell, club forelimbs. Smashes blast doors (x4). Mauls colonists.

aliens.name: Spitter
aliens.trait: Tall four-legged stilt-walker. Stops at range and lobs acid at structures from its throat sac.

aliens.name: Snatcher
aliens.trait: Lean crouched sprinter with hooked arms. Dodges 35% of aimed shots, hunts colonists and drags them off.

aliens.name: Burrower
aliens.trait: Segmented worm with a drill-tooth maw. Tunnels under walls; only Seismic reaches it underground.

aliens.name: Brood Mother
aliens.trait: Boss. Four times a Stalker, egg-sac abdomen, crown of horns. Births broods, gorges to grow.

feeding._comment: Aliens that eat a corpse grow: size x(1+growth_per_meal) up to max_size, +hp_per_meal x base HP. Human remains count as human_meal_mult meals. Grown aliens leave corpses worth more Biomass (x size).
